candidates.name: Vestibular disorder

candidates.why: The patient's symptoms of vertigo, unsteadiness, and wide-based gait suggest a vestibular disorder

candidates.name: Atherosclerotic disease
support_spans: CT angiography demonstrated carotid tortuosity with stenosis from myointimal plaques

candidates.why: The patient's carotid stenosis and plaques suggest atherosclerotic disease
